instrument: RIPE Atlas one-off sslcert (SNI), one probe per country; reconciled against per-pointer fetch

exception.public_note: One member state's endpoint failed TLS validation from every one of the countries measured; disclosed to its operator, detail withheld pending a reasonable interval.

methodology: A bare TLS probe with no SNI reports a CDN's default certificate as a defect; even with SNI, cloud routing can hand a default certificate to some vantages. Every figure here reconciles the Atlas run against a fetch of each pointer's actual URL. After reconciliation exactly one endpoint fails from every country and every method; all others validate when fetched the way software fetches them, with SNI.
